notes: TESTER BUILD: this release has not had a clean fleet pass yet; it is published so testers can run the newest build.
Control panel: the theme editor now opens inside the control panel, as an Editor tab after Portals. The separate editor window stays.
Portals shows every portal at once: the theme cards side by side, wrapping to fit the window. A card with no picture shows the Sigil mark.
A portal your plan does not include opens its editor whole but locked: every setting shown dimmed, with one Upgrade row naming the plan and its price. Nothing it writes is saved.
Cyber City: its editor opens at once, even on a new install (it could sit blank for up to 20 seconds), and the portal uses far less of the processor.
